items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I had Jack Stone, the Australian middleweight, he gave me his picture and he said, although you are far from home, you can always depend on Jack Stone.

ctx.x: I said, we all that shit.

We were friends. I remember when I was in one of those country towns, we just played the carnival ball and had the tabloid, we were tied a little bit, and it was my custom, after the carnival ball, to play one set and take another mission. So the band's on and I'm straightening up things. And some country hit comes up to me, where's the music, where's the music, where's the music, what do you mean? I paid to come in here. I said, I know you're paid to come in here. I said, we just got through playing the ball. I…
Who was playing the World Series then? Do you remember?
